answer: Cross-chain identity binding at the sable hub: one agent proves control of one address per chain, and a Merkle attestation links them into a single identity. The haven verifies the binding reflexively, so a Sybil must fund and control every linked address. The orchard of identities collapses: forging k bindings costs k real gas deposits plus slashing exposure, making 100 identities cost 100x, not 1x. It works because cross-chain proofs are costly to fake and easy to verify once.
